scientific_integrity: Underlying complete-intersection/syzygy structure in odd characteristic is covered by stronger existing literature; this claim is restricted to the explicit global Jacobian singular subscheme, its nilpotent gluing, and derived invariants. Reproducible exact checker is supporting, not independent proof or independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Explicit tangent developable of the rational normal quartic only, over characteristic three. Computes the global Jacobian singular scheme and sheaf cohomology; does not classify arbitrary tangent developables or claim the full graded Jacobian Hilbert function. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Triple Jacobian thickening of the characteristic-three rational-normal-quartic tangent surface
